title.narrative: Scaling up of interventions to combat tuberculosis in Côte d’Ivoire - Côte d'Ivoire (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Côte d'Ivoire, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire (MOH - PNLT)This program has the following goals: Reduce the mortality rate due to TB by 20 percent between 2015 and 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Increase case notification of new and relapse cases from 21,357 in 2016 to 22,795 in 2020. By 2020 (2019 cohort) achieve a treatment success rate of 87 percent among new and relapse cases. Increase the proportion of TB patients tested for HIV from 98 percent in 2016 to 100 percent from 2018 and the proportion of TB/HIV patients treated with ART from 90 percent in 2015 to 100 percent by 2018. Increase the treatment success rate among those treated for multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) from 81 percent in 2015 to 86 percent by 2020. Improve and strengthen the NTCP’s technical, management and coordination capacities

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP04
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases

TB O-5 (M): TB treatment coverage: Percentage of new and relapse cases that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB cases in the same Year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed)
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Impact indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP04
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP04
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of children <5 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Percentage of reporting units reporting no stock-outs of anti-TB drugs on the last day of the quarter
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
